notes.title: Kickstarter news + Update v0.0.142
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m excited to share that we’ve reached 30% of the goal on Kickstarter! 🚀 Your support means the world to me, and I truly appreciate every pledge and share.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maiokgames/big-boy-adventure-pixel-indie-game?ref=7rel6m]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maiokgames/big-boy-adventure-pixel-indie-game?ref=7rel6m[/url]

There are still 24 days left in the campaign, and I’m hopeful we can reach the finish line together! If you enjoy the project, please consider sharing it with friends, fellow indie game lovers, or anyone who might be interested. It really helps!

In the meantime, I’ve been making steady progress on the game. I’ve added new animations for grass and plants, improved the rain effects in the Deep Forest, and enhanced lighting and shadows in various scenes to make the visuals even more immersive and captivating.

Thank you again for being part of this journey! More updates coming soon!

Update Changelog v0.0.014:

Area Special Attack → Increased range.
Bug Fix → Fixed an issue where enemies spawned in incorrect positions in Deep Forest.
First House → Fixed collider issues.
UI Improvements → Now you can close Notifications, Tutorials, and Signs by pressing E or clicking the "X" button.
Bug Fix → Resolved issues with different monitor resolutions.
Environmental Enhancements → Added small grass and flower animations, including interactions when walking over them.
Balance Adjustments → Adjusted damage balance for Red Rose enemy.
Visual Improvements → Enhanced rain effects in Deep Forest

See you soon,
Maiok Games

notes.title: New enemy PoisonChomp! - v0.0.141
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h3]Added new enemy[/h3]
PoisonChomp, attacks from a distance by throwing poisonous pools!


[h3]Other Features[/h3]
-Added roguelike elements (every time you enter a scene with enemies, they respawn randomly in Deep Forest and Caves).
-Removed the ability to save if the player is in a scene with roguelike enemies.
-Added game credits.
-Optimized in-game objects.
-Special attack: the total time to press the button for performing the special attack is now reduced (0.5 seconds).

[h1]Kickstarter coming soon[/h1]
Follow me on Kickstarter to help me! When the game-project is published on kickstarter, you will receive a notification:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maiokgames/big-boy-adventure-pixel-indie-game]Kickstarter Projeck[/url]

[h1]Bug fixed[/h1]
-Deep Forest enemies started shooting before you could enter the fight room.
-Fixed item positioning in the inventory menu.
-HP bar: corrected the HP bar color based on the current health.
-Redrawn fruits/vegetables.

notes.title: Big Boy Adventure v0.0.14 - Demo update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
Here is the first Big Boy Adventure update for you!

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]
Today I finally release a new version of Big Boy Adventure, which replaces the previous versions and introduces great new features in the combat system and more!

[h2]New Combat System[/h2]  
When performing a special attack, hold down the button (right-click mouse) until the charge reaches its maximum level.  
Releasing the button too early will cancel the attack.  
However, if you release the button after the charge is complete, you’ll unleash the new splash attack!  
This area attack deals significantly more damage than a basic attack and also pushes enemies further away.  

[h2]Item Discarding[/h2]  
Discarding an item from your inventory will no longer destroy it immediately. Instead, the item will drop at your current location and remain there until you leave the scene. Once you change scenes, the discarded item will be permanently lost.  

[h2]Enhanced Save System[/h2]  
Saving your progress is now simpler than ever. You can easily create new save files or overwrite existing ones. The improved system is not only more intuitive but also includes an automatic save feature for added convenience.  

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]  
* Resolved a bug where some broken crates failed to drop any coin rewards.  
* Fixed an issue where picking up items with a full inventory caused the items to disappear.  
* Addressed a scene change error that occasionally froze the character.  
* Corrected Larry’s animation near the forest entrance.
* Fixed the unintended appearance of purple toxic fumes during the game’s first earthquake.
